hookups.source: ReserveAmerica per-site catalog for parkId 880401 (42 Modern Electric sites list 50-amp, 9 list 30-amp; no public site lists water or sewer) + https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/frances-slocum-state-park/stay ('some have electric hookups'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: 73 drive-in RV-capable sites on the booking site (51 Modern Electric, 22 Modern Non-Electric) besides 8 drive-in tent-only and 15 walk-to tent sites; DCNR calls it a 100-site campground with 85 tent or trailer sites. Listed max vehicle lengths run 15-50 ft; 45 of the 73 take 25 ft or more and 7 take 50. One pull-through (site 036, 40 ft); the rest are back-in.

sites.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/frances-slocum-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880401 (site list and each site's details page: Max Vehicle Length, Driveway Entry), read 2026-10-20

facilities.source: https://www.pa.gov/agencies/dcnr/recreation/where-to-go/state-parks/find-a-park/frances-slocum-state-park/stay ('Flush toilets, showers, drinking water, sanitary dump station, and boat launch are available'), read 2026-10-20

values.note: Campsites can be booked up to 11 months ahead and for the same day (ReserveAmerica booking window).

booking.source: https://pennsylvaniastateparks.reserveamerica.com/camping/frances-slocum-state-park/r/campgroundDetails.do?contractCode=PA&parkId=880401 (Booking Window: 'Reservations can be made for today and can be made up to 11 Month(s) in advance'), read 2026-10-20

summary: Confirmed inherited reservable/ReserveAmerica/11-month window for this park; season already manual (mid-April to mid-October). Added 50-amp electric, 73 RV sites to 50 ft with one pull-through, showers/flush toilets/drinking water/dump. Not stated for this park: minimum/maximum stay, the noon cutoff, fcfs, water/sewer at sites (only the host site is said to have them). Fees left at the statewide table.
